reviewer: editorial review against the QC rubric

reasons.retention: Resolved. The longest stretch without new on-screen information is now under eight seconds, and the added line at 0:13 gives the zoom sequence a reason to exist beyond waiting.
reasons.twist: Unchanged in substance and better placed. The beat now falls at 50% of the voiceover instead of 40%, so the escalation has somewhere to go.
reasons.visual: Unchanged. Still the strongest look in the batch.

overrides.weak_ending: Flagged because the closing pair introduces no new vocabulary. Overridden: the repetition is the device. 'All of them looking at the screen / All of them looking at him' turns on the swapped object, and any new word in that position would break the anaphora. The lexical novelty test cannot see a rhetorical turn.

rewrite_note: Rewrote the 0:13-0:25 stretch so every caption introduces new information, moved the twist beat from 40% to 50% of the voiceover, and replaced the duplicated 'screen is on' beat with a line that advances the reveal.
